name: Reminders
description: Personal notices at the time you choose, standalone or linked to a record, and the 8 a.m. notice with the tasks of the day.

page.title: My reminders
page.description: Reminders are personal: only you see them. At the set time you get a notice in Aphel, by e-mail and in the browser, following your notification preferences.

pending.title: No pending reminders
pending.description: Create a reminder to be notified on a day and time, or use Remind me on a record page.

sent.title: No sent reminders
sent.description: Reminders that already notified you appear here.

dismissed.title: No dismissed reminders
dismissed.description: Reminders you dismissed before their time appear here.

dialog.description: Choose when you want to be notified.
dialog.whenRequired: Choose the day and time of the notice.

remove.title: Delete this reminder?
remove.description: It will be removed and you will no longer be notified.
